artifact_families.purpose: Workspace notes tracked directly in git.
artifact_families.notes: Keep in git. Replace notes with conference-local guidance if needed.

artifact_families.purpose: Conference-local configuration contract tracked directly in git.
artifact_families.notes: Keep in git. Point storage.manifest_path at this file.

artifact_families.purpose: Workspace manifest, policy notes, inventory, and verification evidence tracked directly in git.
artifact_families.notes: Storage contract artifacts stay versioned in git.

artifact_families.purpose: Static workspace assets tracked directly in git.
artifact_families.notes: Remove or expand if a future conference does not use this family.

artifact_families.purpose: Conference-local helper scripts tracked directly in git.
artifact_families.notes: Remove or expand if a future conference does not use this family.

artifact_families.purpose: Analysis notes, deep reports, slide briefs, manifests, and proof markdown retained in git and mirrored to private backup when requested.
artifact_families.notes: Markdown analysis deliverables are Git-owned for reviewability. Backup sync may mirror them to Drive, but Git remains the source of truth.

artifact_families.purpose: Presentation workspace lane and Git-owned source/control surface.
artifact_families.notes: Keeps the deck lane trackable while generated payload families below own Drive sync for HTML, images, SVGs, PDFs, video, audio, and JSON.

artifact_families.purpose: Presentation markdown sources, scripts, QC summaries, and human-reviewable deck text.
artifact_families.notes: Markdown deck sources stay Git-owned so slide and narration changes are reviewable. Drive sync can mirror them for sharing.

artifact_families.purpose: Presentation manifest used as a small control/proof file for generated decks.
artifact_families.notes: Small control artifact tracked in Git and optionally mirrored with public/backup presentation bundles.

artifact_families.purpose: Rendered Reveal.js presentation HTML prepared for sharing.
artifact_families.notes: Generated HTML is a Drive-owned payload; rebuild from markdown and templates when needed.

artifact_families.purpose: Rendered slide screenshots, thumbnails, and other generated PNG assets.
artifact_families.notes: Generated image payloads are synced to Drive rather than committed.

artifact_families.purpose: Generated programmatic SVG figures used by presentation decks.
artifact_families.notes: Generated SVG payloads are synced to Drive rather than committed; figure-generation code and markdown references remain reviewable.

artifact_families.purpose: Exported deck PDFs prepared for sharing.
artifact_families.notes: Generated PDF payloads are synced to Drive rather than committed.

artifact_families.purpose: Generated presenter or NotebookLM-style presentation videos.
artifact_families.notes: Generated video payloads are synced to Drive rather than committed.

artifact_families.purpose: Intermediate video build workdirs containing temporary slide renders, audio segments, concat files, and scratch metadata.
artifact_families.notes: Scratch video build directories are ignored and not synced; final video payloads are owned by presentation_video_payloads.

artifact_families.purpose: Generated narration audio payloads used by presentation videos.
artifact_families.notes: Generated audio payloads are synced to Drive rather than committed.

artifact_families.purpose: Generated per-topic presentation metadata such as slide mappings, sanity reports, and structure outputs.
artifact_families.notes: Generated per-topic JSON payloads are synced to Drive rather than committed; the top-level presentation manifest remains Git-owned.

artifact_families.purpose: Generated presentation asset metadata, repair receipts, and visual-QC JSON sidecars.
artifact_families.notes: Generated asset JSON payloads are synced to Drive rather than committed.

artifact_families.purpose: Podcast, narration, or other audio release outputs.
artifact_families.notes: Use only if the conference workspace produces shareable audio artifacts.

artifact_families.purpose: Export bundles for deeper analysis workflows.
artifact_families.notes: Large working exports are private by default.

artifact_families.purpose: Exhaustive topic extraction outputs keyed by run id: by-artifact/ and by-topic/ records, the LLM full-read lane (llm-full-read/), and v15_extraction_coverage.json.
artifact_families.notes: The owner (conference_pipeline.iclr2025_live.run_exhaustive_topic_extraction) writes storage/extractions/<run-id>/; the old exports/exhaustive-extractions path never existed, so the backup profile silently skipped this family (found on CVPR 2026, 2026-09-18; fixed here 2026-09-27).

artifact_families.purpose: Packaged NotebookLM source bundle: chunked sources, manifest, index, and per-topic plus conference-wide Audio-Overview podcast prompts.
artifact_families.notes: Regenerable via scripts/package_conference_for_notebook_lm_export.py; backed up privately so the deep-dive bundle and podcast prompts reach Drive.
